knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A correction is shown with a single line, the new value, initials, date and reason so the original stays readable.
A handover covers open issues, hazards, referrals and restrictions so the next person does not miss them.
A consistent log shows trends across visits so changes are noticed early.

practicalCriteria: Learner completes procedure step 1: Record the date, time, weather, air temperature and water temperature in Celsius before any other entry.
Learner completes procedure step 2: Enter each reading with its unit, depth, instrument and any observation, following the sampling lesson.
Learner completes procedure step 3: Record the state of each piece of equipment, the debris and sludge removed by volume, and any water added or removed with its approval.
Learner completes procedure step 4: Record the wildlife observed, the netting check, any mortality or disease, and the referrals made.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 1: Record the date, time, weather, air temperature and water temperature in Celsius before any other entry.
Record of procedure step 3: Record the state of each piece of equipment, the debris and sludge removed by volume, and any water added or removed with its approval.
Record of procedure step 4: Record the wildlife observed, the netting check, any mortality or disease, and the referrals made.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 4 is not done: Record the wildlife observed, the netting check, any mortality or disease, and the referrals made.
Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Write the handover note with open issues, hazards, referrals, what must not be done, and the next visit date.
